correctness.rationale: Exact one-dimensional sketched orthogonality and least-squares normal equations yield coefficient formulae. Gaussian orthogonal invariance yields independent chi and standard-normal variables. The derived continuous density is strictly positive at the sFOM pole; integration gives the sharp q<1 threshold and leading tail constant. The affine Student law gives q<m for sGMRES. Direct quadratic expansion proves the mean-square energy formula; a standalone package checker verifies finite algebra/density identities but is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact unconditional moment threshold for two competing published projection objectives is a meaningful reliability distinction: infinitely many Gaussian rows in expectation do not help at any finite sketch dimension for sFOM, whereas sGMRES gains finite variance for m>2. The exact tail constant quantifies how rare failures evade ordinary testing, and the two-dimensional SPD benchmark provides a reproducible reference for solver choice and safeguards.
